sorrisós: sorrisar(se) — he smiled (preterite 3rd sg. sorrisó + reflexive se reduced to -s; Sorrisós de la boca 'he smiled with his mouth'; = se sonrió; compare sonrrisándose, the gerund with se)
amigol: amigo + l(e) — a friend to him (amigo + le, dative le elided to -l after the noun; amigol sodes 'you are his friend'; = sois su amigo; the le read as the Cid, 'friend to him'; the reading is not certain)
llegare: llegar — may (He) bring, may (He) let me arrive (future subjunctive 3rd sg. in -re, in an if-clause, here transitive 'to bring'; Si Dios me llegare al Çid 'if God lets me reach the Cid'; modern si + present indicative, si Dios me lleva; the future subjunctive is lost in modern Spanish)
perderedes: perder — you will lose (future 2nd pl., perder + edes, the old -edes ending; non perderedes nada 'you will lose nothing'; = perderéis)
adobada: adobar — made ready, prepared (past part. fem. sg., agreeing with çena; la çena es adobada 'supper is prepared'; = preparada; modern adobar means 'to season, marinate')
sirvíalos: servir + los — he was serving them (imperfect 3rd sg. sirvía + enclitic los, set after the verb that opens the clause; sirvíalos Minaya 'Minaya waited on them'; = los servía)
fueron: seer/ir — they were (preterite 3rd pl., shared by ser and ir; todos fueron alegres 'all were glad'; = fueron)
çerviçio: çerviçio — service, hospitality, provisions supplied (del çerviçio que tomaran 'of the service they had received'; = servicio)
tomaran: tomar — they had taken, received (pluperfect indicative 3rd pl. in -ra, the Latin pluperfect; que tomaran 'which they had received'; = habían tomado; Pidal's tomara[n])
medinal: Medina + l(e) — Medina (Medinaceli) with elided le: en Medinal sacaran 'they had taken out at Medina for him'; = en Medina le; le dative, uncertain who it is; see Medina
sacaran: sacar — they had taken out, drawn (pluperfect 3rd pl. in -ra; conducho … sacaran 'provisions they had drawn'; = habían sacado)
passada: passar — passed, gone (past part. fem. sg. with ser, agreeing with noche; Passada es la noche 'the night is past'; = pasada)
venida: venir — come, arrived (past part. fem. sg. with ser; venida es la mañana 'morning has come'; = venida)
oída: oír — heard (past part. fem. sg. with ser; oída es la missa 'mass has been heard'; = oída)
cavalgavan: cavalgar — they rode, mounted (imperfect 3rd pl.; luego cavalgavan 'at once they mounted'; = cabalgaban)
passavan: passar — they crossed, passed (imperfect 3rd pl.; Salón passavan 'they crossed the Jalón'; = pasaban)
luégol: luego + l(e) — at once it (luego + le; le probably takes up el campo as object, an odd use, so not certain; luégol atravessavan 'at once they crossed it'; = luego lo atravesaban; the accent shows the stress stays on lué-)
atravessavan: atravessar — they were crossing (imperfect 3rd pl.; el campo … atravessavan 'they crossed the plain'; = atravesaban)
aguardava: aguardar — he was guarding, looking after (imperfect 3rd sg.; Pidal restores aguarda[va]; las dueñas aguardava 'he looked after the ladies'; = aguardaba, but modern aguardar means 'to wait for', here 'to guard, care for')
hivan: ir — they went (imperfect 3rd pl., h- only spelling; hivan a una compaña 'they went together as one company'; = iban)
entrados: entrar — entered (past part. masc. pl. with ser; Entrados son 'they have entered'; = entrados)
sirvié: servir — he was serving (imperfect 3rd sg. in -ié; bien los sirvié 'he served them well'; = servía)
quisieron: querer — they wished (strong preterite 3rd pl.; de quanto que quisieron 'of all they wanted'; = quisieron)
ferraduras: ferradura — horseshoes, the shoeing of horses (pl.; ferraduras quitar gelas mandava 'he had the horseshoes (cost) cleared for them'; = herraduras; Latin ferrum)
ondrava: ondrar — he was honoring (imperfect 3rd sg.; ¡Dios cómmo las ondrava! 'God, how he honored them!'; = honraba)
manaña: mañana — morning, as printed manaña without the tilde (otro día manaña 'next morning'; = mañana; so printed, the first n without the tilde)
despendié: despender — he was spending (imperfect 3rd sg. in -ié; lo so despendié el moro 'the Moor spent of his own'; = gastaba; despender survives only as a rare word; Latin dispendere)
ondradas: ondrado — honored, splendid (past part. as adj. fem. pl.; nuevas tan ondradas 'such honored tidings'; = honradas)
leguas: legua — league, a measure of distance (pl.; a tres leguas contadas 'three full leagues away'; = leguas)
contadas: contar — counted, full (past part. fem. pl.; leguas contadas 'full, reckoned leagues'; = contadas)
mandádol: mandado + l(e) — the message to him (mandado + dative le, the accent showing the stress stays on -dá-; el mandádol levavan 'they carried the message to him'; = el mandado le llevaban; the ol is Pidal's restoration)
amava: amar — he loved (imperfect 3rd sg.; lo que más amava 'what he loved most'; = amaba)
yál: ya + l(e) — now to him (ya 'already, now' + dative le; yál viene el mandado 'now the news comes to him'; = ya le viene)
reçiban: reçebir — may they receive (present subjunctive 3rd pl., purpose after que; que reçiban a Minaya 'that they receive Minaya'; = reciban)
sedíe: seer — he was sitting, was staying (imperfect 3rd sg., printed sedíe, stressed on the í, beside the unaccented sedie elsewhere; Latin sedebat; él sedíe en Valençia 'he stayed in Valencia'; = estaba, sedía no longer used)
curiando: curiar — guarding, watching over (gerund; Latin curare; curiando e guardando 'on guard and watching'; no modern form, closest cuidar)
guardassen: guardar — (that) they guard (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. in -ssen, after mandó; que guardassen el alcáçer 'that they guard the citadel'; = guardaran / guardasen)
aduxiéssenle: aduzir + le — (that) they bring him (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. aduxiessen + enclitic le, after mandó; e aduxiéssenle a Bavieca 'and that they bring Bavieca to him'; = que le trajeran; modern aducir means only 'to adduce')
bavieca: Bavieca — Babieca, the Cid's horse (proper name; = Babieca)
ganara: ganar — he had won (pluperfect 3rd sg. in -ra; quel ganara 'that he had won him'; = había ganado)
sabié: saber — he knew (imperfect 3rd sg. in -ié; aun non sabié 'he did not yet know'; = sabía)
corredor: corredor — runner, fast horse (noun from correr; si serié corredor 'whether he would be a runner'; = corredor, closest caballo veloz)
ssi: si — if, whether (ss- only a spelling of initial s; = si)
abrié: aver — he would have (conditional 3rd sg., the infinitive aver + the imperfect ending -ié, Latin habere + habebat; ssi abrié buena parada 'whether he would have a good halt'; = habría)
parada: parada — halt, stopping (noun from parar; the horse's stop at the end of the run; buena parada 'a good stop'; = parada)
reçebidas: reçebir — received (past part. fem. pl., absolute with las dueñas; Reçebidas las dueñas 'the ladies having been received'; = recibidas)
ondrança: ondrança — honor, ceremony (a grant ondrança 'with great honor'; = honra, closest honra/pompa)
dexava: dexar — he was leaving (imperfect 3rd sg.; dexava el cavallo 'he left his horse'; = dejaba)
oras: ora — hour, time (fem. pl.; con oras 'in time, in good time': que con oras se acordaran 'who had made ready in time', Pidal's reading, which he queries; Bello's 'gathered to pray the (canonical) hours' he calls arbitrary; = horas)
acordaran: acordar(se) — they had made ready, prepared themselves (pluperfect 3rd pl. in -ra, with se; que con oras se acordaran 'who had made ready in time', Pidal 'se habían preparado', with a query; compare acordados foron, v. 3059; = se habían preparado; sense not certain)
sobrepelliças: sobrepelliça — surplice, the white liturgical garment worn by clergy (pl.; = sobrepellices, from sobrepelliz)
cruzes: cruz — cross (pl.; cruzes de plata 'crosses of silver'; = cruces)
reçibir: reçebir — to receive (infinitive; reçibir salién 'they came out to receive'; = recibir)
salién: salir — they were coming out (imperfect 3rd pl. in -ié, salién + infinitive of purpose; salién reçibir 'they came out to receive'; = salían)
vistiós: vestir + se — he put on (preterite 3rd sg. vistió + reflexive se reduced to -s; vistiós el sobregonel 'he put on the sobregonel'; = se vistió)
sobregonel: sobregonel — a garment worn over the other clothes (sobre + gonel(a), a tunic; Pidal: an unknown word, some kind of gonela or silk tunic; vistiós el sobregonel 'he put on the surcoat'; no modern form)
ensiéllanle: ensellar + le — they saddle for him (present 3rd pl. in the narrative present + enclitic le; ensiéllanle a Bavieca 'they saddle Bavieca for him'; = le ensillan; ensillar)
echavan: echar — they were putting, throwing on (imperfect 3rd pl.; cuberturas le echavan 'they put the caparisons on him'; = echaban)
fuste: fuste — wood, a wooden shaft, lance (Latin fustis; armas de fuste 'arms of wood', lances for the display; = fuste)
ésta: ésta — this (fem. demonstrative pronoun, accented in Pidal's print; ésta fo tan estraña 'this was so extraordinary'; = ésta)
corrido: correr — run (past part.; quando ovo corrido 'when he had run'; = corrido)
maravillavan: maravillar — they marveled (imperfect 3rd pl., with se, maravillarse 'to marvel'; todos se maravillavan 'all marveled'; = maravillaban)
des: des — from (des día 'from that day', short for desde aquel día; des = desde; = desde)
preçió: preçiar — he was esteemed (preterite 3rd sg., with se 'became prized, famous'; se preçió Bavieca 'Bavieca became famous'; = fue apreciado; modern se preció would mean 'prided himself')
quant: quant — as much as, how far (apocopated quanto, with grant; en quant grant fo España 'throughout the whole extent of Spain'; = cuan, cuanto)
cosso: cosso — course, run, racing ground (Latin cursus; en cabo del cosso 'at the end of the course'; = coso, now mainly 'bullring')
merced: merced — mercy, favor, grace (noun; Merced, Campeador 'mercy, thanks, Campeador', the word of a suppliant or of thanks; = merced)
sacada: sacar — rescued, taken out (past part. fem. sg. agreeing with me; Sacada me avedes 'you have rescued me'; = sacada)
vergüenças: vergüença — shame, disgrace, affronts (fem. pl.; vergüenças malas 'bad affronts'; = vergüenzas)
afeme: afe + me — behold me, here I am (afe presentative + me, as afevos; afeme aquí 'here I am'; = heme aquí)
criadas: criar — brought up, reared, well bred (past part. fem. pl.; buenas son e criadas 'they are good and well brought up'; = criadas)
abraçava: abraçar — he was embracing (imperfect 3rd sg.; = abrazaba)
avíen: aver — they had (imperfect 3rd pl. in -íen, full verb 'to have, feel'; del gozo que avíen 'from the joy they felt'; = tenían, habían)
deleyt: deleyt — delight, pleasure, festivity (en grant deleyt 'in great delight'; = deleite)
tenien: tener — they held; with armas, they played at arms (imperfect 3rd pl. in -ién; armas tenien 'they played at arms', Pidal 'jugaban las armas'; = tenían)
tablados: tablado — a little castle of boards set up as a target, which knights struck with their lances to bring it down (pl.; tablados crebantavan 'they broke down the board castles'; Pidal 'castillejo de tablas'; = tablado, now 'stage, platform')
crebantavan: crebantar — they were breaking (imperfect 3rd pl.; the cr and the van Pidal's: [cr]ebanta[van]; = quebrantaban)
querida: querer — beloved (past part. fem. sg. used as adj.; querida mugier 'beloved wife'; = querida)
besavan: besar — they were kissing (imperfect 3rd pl.; las manos le besavan 'they kissed his hands'; = besaban)

__broaden__.quito: quitar — I leave, give up (present 1st sg.) · also quitar — 'I release, pardon, lift the ban on' (a vos quito, Minaya 'I pardon you, Minaya'; = perdono) · also quito — free, quit, cleared (adjective, of a debt or charge; quito se va Minaya 'Minaya goes away free of charge'; Latin quietus; = libre, exento)
__broaden__.mandava: mandar — he ordered, was ordering (imperfect 3rd sg.; a sos creenderos guardar lo mandava 'he told his trusted men to guard him'; = mandaba) · also mandar — he was governing, held (imperfect 3rd sg., of a place; la que Avengalvón mandava 'which Avengalvón ruled'; = gobernaba)
__broaden__.quitar: quitar — to leave, quit (infinitive; el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'; = quitar, closest abandonar) · also 'to set free' (quiero las i quitar 'I mean to free them there'; Pidal: 'libertar') · also quitar — to clear, remit (a charge; quitar lo mandava 'he ordered it cleared, i.e. paid or remitted'; quitar gelas 'to clear them for them')
__broaden__.diestro: diestro — right (hand, side), noun use (de diestro 'on the right'; = diestro, closest derecha) · also diestro — adjective 'right' (so diestro braço 'his right arm'); mio diestro braço 'my right arm', figuratively my chief support · also en diestro — led unmounted at the rider's right hand, of the warhorse (buen cavallo en diestro 'a good warhorse led at his right'; Pidal: cavallo en diestro, Old French destrier)
__broaden__.avié: aver — he had (imperfect of aver = haber, here a full verb 'to have, hold') · also impersonal 'there was' (mucho avié grant plaça 'there was a very great space'; = había) · also avié — auxiliary 'had' + participle, pluperfect (avié dado 'he had given'; = había dado) · also poco avié que — 'a short time before' (impersonal, of time; poco avié quel ganara 'it was little time since he had won him'; = hacía poco)
__broaden__.una: uno/una — one, a (fem.) · also a una — together, as one (adverbial; hivan a una compaña 'they went together'; a una grant ondrança 'together with great honor'; = juntos)
__broaden__.del: de + el — of the (contraction) · also del standing for de + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (del albergada = de la albergada) · also del — 'from, for, because of' (cause; del gozo 'from the joy'; del çerviçio 'for the service')
__broaden__.corrida: corrida — raid, foray (noun from correr; fizo una corrida 'he made a raid'; = corrida, closest correría) · also corrida — a run, a display gallop of a horse (fizo una corrida 'he made a run'; Pidal: 'alarde de equitación a galope', Old French eslai)
__broaden__.tener: tener — to hold, keep (infinitive, first element of the split future tener la edes 'you will hold it'; = tener) · also tener las armas — to play at arms, exercise in them and show skill (Pidal: 'jugar las armas')
__broaden__.presentaja: presentaja — gift, present (dar en presentaja 'to give as a gift'; Pidal: 'presente, regalo') · also an offer, a price proposed (d'aquesta presentaja 'with this offer'; Pidal: 'oferta o proposición de precio'); no modern form, closest presente, oferta · also courtesy, kind treatment (plazme desta presentaja 'this courtesy pleases me'; Pidal: 'obsequio, agasajo')
